about:
Mach Connections operates from Bowling Green, Florida, as a subsidiary of the Correct Craft family of companies. The business was acquired and rebranded in 2022, building on a team with extensive experience in the marine electrical sector.

The company specializes in OEM panel production, hydro graphics, wire harness manufacturing, and battery cable assemblies. Its engineering services support custom panel design and custom battery cable design for marine electrical systems, and the team consults on wiring harness needs for specific applications.

Mach Connections serves the marine industry, supplying OEMs and directly serving boaters who need reliable electrical solutions. Its products are designed to keep boats connected and operating efficiently, with a focus on tailored wiring harnesses and cable assemblies.

The company emphasizes high-quality products and exceptional customer service, with a team dedicated to identifying the most suitable electrical solutions for each application. It has rapidly gained recognition as a leader in the marine electrical niche.
